tool_name: Group 6 Tool Output Provenance & Injection Risk Analyzer
limitations: Scores are heuristic indicators, not probabilities.
A suspicious pattern is not proof of an attack.
Shared task IDs do not prove causation.
Detection depends on the fields present in the logs.
This prototype does not modify ADOP or block actions.
Source-to-action correlation uses available task IDs and sequence numbers, with input-order fallback; it does not prove causation.
